column1: # Reviews of pins that are behind their upstream, read by tools/check-pin-reviews.sh.
#   package  pinned  reviewed_up_to  fine|held  date  what was read, and why
# reviewed_up_to: upstream's newest in the survey (check-source-currency.sh --tsv) on that date.
# fine: nothing released after the pin, up to reviewed_up_to, is a security fix that reaches Kryptik.
# held: something is, and the note says why the pin stays. A pin that has caught up has no row.
# Read from upstream NEWS and changelogs, security pages, the Debian security tracker and NVD.

binutils      2.43.1   2.47     fine  2026-09-19  NEWS 2.44 to 2.47 and the Debian tracker: every CVE since 2.43 is a crafted-input bug in tools that are only fed the project's own objects, and upstream's SECURITY.txt excludes them; no wrong-code or hardening fix found.

gcc           14.4.0   16.2.0   fine  2026-09-19  14.4.0 is the newest 14.x. 15 changes the default C standard and 16 the default C++ one; neither is a security release. GCC Bugzilla milestones for 14.3 and 14.4 were read when the pin moved off 14.2.0.

glibc         2.40     2.44     fine  2026-09-19  The tarball is 2.40 and build/patches/glibc-2.40 carries upstream's maintained release/2.40/master branch to cdaa5d6d (2026-09-10), which is where 2.40's security fixes live. Re-read that branch's head when this row is next reviewed. GLIBC-SA-2026-0022 (CVE-2026-86805, the loader's $ORIGIN check racing for setuid programs; fixed only for 2.45) needs a setuid program whose RPATH climbs out of $ORIGIN, and fs.protected_hardlinks off: su and passwd carry no RPATH (the artifact audit lists every one in the image) and build/config/sysctl.d sets protected_hardlinks to 1.

glibc-branch  cdaa5d6db08e  9bc3c99bffba  fine  2026-10-15  build/patches/glibc-2.40's 0001 carries release/2.40/master to cdaa5d6d. The branch's one commit since, 9bc3c99b (2026-10-13), fixes an off-by-one in the AT_HWCAP4 loop of sysdeps/powerpc/dl-procinfo.h, reached only on PowerPC: nothing in it builds for x86-64. Move the patch to the branch head when the branch next fixes generic or x86-64 code.

rustc         1.98.1   1.99.1   fine  2026-10-16  Release notes 1.99.0: language, lint, library and Cargo changes; no security fix. 1.99.1 fixes a miscompilation that 1.99.0 brought in on x86-64, a bool returned to C with its upper bits left set (rust-lang/rust#163911: rustc stopped marking the return zeroext), and wcslen on UEFI and rust-lld's rpath on macOS; 1.98.1 still masks the bool. Never 1.99.0. The browser's layer and kryptikd (build/config/rust.lock) move together.

llvm          23.1.3   23.1.4   fine  2026-10-23  The 34 commits from llvmorg-23.1.3 to 23.1.4: code generation fixes (X86, ARM, AArch64, PowerPC, Mips, SPARC, NVPTX, SelectionDAG, InstCombine, GlobalISel), Clang's counted_by through unions, lld's ELF layout, llvm-objcopy, llvm-ar and release tooling; no security fix. Only the browser's build uses this release build (build/images/clang.sh): bindgen's libclang reads Firefox's headers and llvm-objdump answers configure. GCC compiles the browser and rustc brings its own LLVM, so none of its code generation reaches the image.
mpc           1.3.1    1.4.1    fine  2026-09-19  NEWS 1.4.0 and 1.4.1: no security or wrong-result fix. 1.4.0 is to be skipped if this ever moves.
# --- held: a fix exists upstream and the pin stays, for the reason given -----------
# --- fine: nothing in the gap is a security fix that reaches Kryptik ---------------

gawk          5.3.0    5.4.1    fine  2026-09-26  build/patches/gawk-5.3.0 carries upstream's fixes for CVE-2026-40467 (do_getline_redir use-after-free, a2d18c74), -40468 (do_sub and parse_escape overflows, 062f2f25) and -40553 (readdir extension, cca03661 and bfa2e4b8), made against 5.3.0's text; make check passes. -40469 (aa7272a6) guards 32-bit builds only and is not carried. 5.4 makes MinRX the default regex engine under every build script that calls awk, glibc's and the kernel's included: move in a build of its own, not in a batch.

shadow        4.16.0   4.20.3   fine  2026-09-27  build/patches/shadow-4.16.0 carries 4.17.0's sgetgrent use-after-free fix (8424d7c49462). No CVE is fixed in the gap; 4.20.3 only fixes the build with --with-nscd=no. CVE-2024-56433 is unfixed upstream and does not reach Kryptik: it needs accounts defined on the network with UIDs in the default /etc/subuid range and a setuid newuidmap; nsswitch.conf reads passwd and group from files only, and stage 06's audit-setuid.sh refuses any setuid file but su, so no user can map the subordinate range that zones (uid_base 100000) also use. 4.19 needs --disable-logind, 4.20 changes the login.defs line the recipe edits, removes PASS_MIN_DAYS and makes su - fail unless TIOCSTI is off. Target 4.19.4, with the recipe.
bash          5.2.32   5.3      fine  2026-09-19  Patches 5.2.33 to 5.2.37 and the 5.3 NEWS: no security fix found. 5.3 needs readline 8.3.
grep          3.11     3.12     fine  2026-09-19  NEWS 3.12: a failure of grep -r on directories with over 100,000 entries; no security fix.

diffutils     3.10     3.12     fine  2026-09-27  NEWS 3.11 and 3.12: no security fix in a release. CVE-2026-53910 (a diff3 overflow on crafted diff output, disputed upstream as a crash) is fixed only in upstream git (9ff04d5b, 73ed7ce8), so a bump would not fix it. It needs whoever runs diff3 to take its diff output from an attacker, e.g. through --diff-program. Nothing in Kryptik runs diff3, and a user or zone that does runs it as itself, crossing no boundary. Never 3.11.
m4            1.4.19   1.4.21   fine  2026-09-19  NEWS 1.4.20 and 1.4.21: build fixes for newer glibc and compilers.

file          5.45     5.48     fine  2026-09-19  ChangeLog 5.46 to 5.48: the stack overrun it mentions is a regression that exists only in 5.46 (checked in readelf.c: 5.45 uses a BUFSIZ buffer there). Never pin 5.46.

zlib          1.3.1    1.3.2    fine  2026-09-25  1.3.2's security fix, CVE-2026-27171 (crc32_combine never returns when a caller passes a negative length; local, low), is carried as upstream's commit (build/patches/zlib-1.3.1). 1.3.2 also INTRODUCES CVE-2026-85091, a heap overflow in gz_vacate that 1.3.1 does not contain (checked: the function is absent); its fix, upstream df84af25dc, is in no release. The rest of 1.3.1.2 and 1.3.2, read commit by commit, is build, portability and defensive work: NULL checks, zeroed state, inflateCopy and deflateCopy copying only initialised memory, a larger deflateBound for unusual calls. Move when a release carries df84af25dc.
zstd          1.5.6    1.5.7    fine  2026-09-19  Release notes 1.5.7: performance and CLI defaults; no security fix.

libffi        3.5.2    3.8.0    fine  2026-09-19  The x86-64 memory access fixes of 3.4.7 and 3.4.8 are in 3.5.2. 3.6 to 3.8 history read; no upstream security page exists, so this rests on that and an NVD search.

openssl       3.5.9    3.6.5    fine  2026-09-30  3.5.9 is the newest release of the 3.5 LTS series (supported to 2030-04-08) and came out the same day as 3.6.5, with the same fixes: CVE-2026-84782 (DTLS retransmission, high), CVE-2026-35189 (CRLDP memory), CVE-2026-35191 and CVE-2026-42772 (QUIC). The one extra fix in 3.6.4, CVE-2026-54876, affects 3.6 and 4.0 only. 3.6 reaches end of life on 2026-11-01.
gettext       0.22.5   1.0      fine  2026-09-19  NEWS 0.23 to 1.0: no security fix. 1.0 changes how po directories are handled.
texinfo       7.1      7.3      fine  2026-09-19  NEWS 7.1.1 to 7.3: no security fix.
libtool       2.4.7    2.6.2    fine  2026-09-19  NEWS 2.5.x and 2.6.x: no security fix.
gperf         3.1      3.3      fine  2026-09-19  NEWS 3.2 and 3.3: no security fix.

pkgconf       2.3.0    3.0.10   fine  2026-10-19  NEWS to 3.0.10: no security fix. 3.0 breaks the libpkgconf ABI, moves to meson and changed quoting and sysroot handling twice; 3.0.8 (2026-10-09) percent-encodes spdxtool URLs, uses the platform path separator in the built-in path variables, and fixes documentation; 3.0.9 (2026-10-15) only adds spdxtool's utility tests to the Autotools build (d71cd7a364); 3.0.10 only corrects the version number meson builds with.

skalibs       2.15.1.0 2.16.0.0 fine  2026-10-19  NEWS and the eight commits to v2.16.0.0: waitpids and waitpids_nohang replace waitn*, openslurpclose_at becomes a macro over openslurpnclose_at, tain_addmsec_g's definition is fixed, header order and Solaris qsort_r detection; no security fix. An API change: execline, s6 and s6-rc move with it.

execline      2.9.9.2  2.10.0.0 fine  2026-10-19  NEWS and the six commits to v2.10.0.0: cd and umask renamed, --enable-pedantic-posix, posix-cd and loopwhilex -n removed, wait rewritten to reap only the pids it lists; no security fix. Kryptik's services and scripts call none of these (no execline script in build/services).

s6            2.15.1.0 2.15.1.1 fine  2026-10-19  The eight commits to v2.15.1.1: READY=1 accepted without a newline, s6-softlimit -h lowering the soft limit, s6-sudod's error reporting, doc typos; no security fix. Kryptik calls neither s6-softlimit nor s6-sudod.

s6-rc         0.7.0.0  0.8.0.2  fine  2026-10-23  NEWS and the 25 commits to v0.8.0.1: compiled databases record their major version, s6-rc-compile -L, snapshots in s6-rc-set-install for upgrades across major versions, s6-rc-update's rollback deleting the right directory, and in 0.8.0.1 alone s6-rc-set-new's naming of a set's .real directory; no security fix. 0.8.0.2's one fix (e3e2e110) gives s6-rc-set-new's rx buffer the byte that 0.8.0.1's longer .real name needs, which it wrote past on the stack: a bug 0.8.0.1 brought in, as 0.7.0.0 sizes that buffer to what it writes (checked). Kryptik compiles its database at build time and runs neither s6-rc-update nor the s6-rc-set commands.

iana-etc      20261009 20261022 fine  2026-10-29  One commit to 20261015: IANA's protocol-numbers.xml and service-names-port-numbers.xml refreshed. One more to 20261022 (b1ff7d76): service-names-port-numbers.xml, +24 -8. Data, no code.
intel-microcode 20260812 20260925 fine  2026-09-27  Release notes 20260925: one functional update, Meteor Lake C0 (06-aa-04, 0x28 to 0x2b), and no security advisory.

linux-firmware 20260916 20261019 fine  2026-10-23  The 206 commits between the tags, read against firmware.list and the AMD microcode stage 05 builds into the kernel. What changes in the image: AMD's family 1Ah microcode (new patches for models 02h and 11h, EPYC 9005: 0x0b00217b and 0x0b101068; models 08h and 24h unchanged); iwlwifi's core24.80-41 builds for cc, Qu and QuZ (-77), ty, So and Ma (-89, with their PNVM files), Bz with Hr or Gf and Sc with Gf (-100); amdgpu's DMCUB, GC, PSP TA and ASD, VCN and VPE updates; and new board entries in the ath11k WCN6855 hw2.0 and ath12k WCN7850 hw2.0 board-2.bin. No commit states a security fix, and no AMD or Intel advisory, Debian tracker entry or NVD record names one in these files; Intel's August Wi-Fi advisories (INTEL-SA-01422, -01468) came before the pin, which carries core24.70-49. Vendors disclose firmware fixes on their own dates: re-read this row when Intel or AMD next publish.

groff         1.23.0   1.24.2   fine  2026-09-29  NEWS 1.24.0 to 1.24.2: 1.24.2 fixes command injection (CWE-78) in mmroff, pdfmom and pre-grohtml, which the image does not install (build/recipes/groff.sh); man renders for a terminal, never HTML. 1.24.0 has incompatible request-syntax changes; never that one.

cmake         4.4.4    4.4.5    fine  2026-10-29  The 19 commits from v4.4.4 to v4.4.5: the cache documentation table, FindPython under cross-compiling with CMP0190 OLD, curl 8.21 or later built without TLS, and GNUInstallDirs' /opt paths. No security fix, and cmake runs only in the build; the image ships no cmake.
cmake-bin     4.4.4    4.4.5    fine  2026-10-29  The same release as cmake (Kitware's x86_64 binary of v4.4.5): the 19 commits above, no security fix, used only in the build and never installed.

lvm2          2.03.42  2.03.44  fine  2026-10-29  WHATS_NEW 2.03.43 and 2.03.44, WHATS_NEW_DM 1.02.217 and 1.02.218 (GitLab's mirror at v2_03_44): no security fix in what Kryptik builds, device-mapper alone (libdevmapper, dmsetup). 1.02.218 handles dm-raid 1.9's incomplete health status, fixes two dmstats leaks, validates dmsetup vdostats' device name and trims log prefixes; 2.03.44's out-of-bounds read in dmeventd's message parser and its new I/O engines are in parts not built.
e2fsprogs     1.47.1   1.47.4   fine  2026-09-19  Release notes 1.47.2 to 1.47.4: no security fix.
libpipeline   1.5.7    1.5.8    fine  2026-09-19  NEWS 1.5.8: no security fix.
man-db        2.12.1   2.13.1   fine  2026-09-19  NEWS 2.13.0 and 2.13.1: no security fix.

perl          5.40.5   5.44.0   fine  2026-09-19  5.40.5 is the newest 5.40.x and has every fix through CVE-2026-13221. 5.40 is in perlpolicy's security-fix window (tools/support-policy.tsv). 5.42 and 5.44 are new series, not security releases.

elfutils      0.191    0.197    fine  2026-10-23  Only libelf is installed: objtool links it when stage 05 builds the kernel, and iproute2's ip and tc use it to load BPF objects (lib/bpf_legacy.c). 43 commits touch libelf in 0.192 to 0.196, and five in 0.197. The fixes for crafted files include elf_strptr on a section without data (CVE-2025-1376, b16f441), the elf_scnshndx rewrite (c65c467), checks on compressed-section and archive-member sizes, 2026's out-of-bounds reads in elf_getarsym and the archive index (b35e1ec, 8b19216, 3a122a0, 681b793), and in 0.197 a bound on the buffer a zstd-compressed section's header makes libelf allocate (0a8e362). 0.197's other libelf commits fix locking in the --enable-thread-safety build, which is not configured, add a reference-count helper libdwfl_stacktrace uses, and sync elf.h. None reaches Kryptik: objtool reads only the build's own objects, and ip and tc parse an object only when root loads it as BPF, which already needs CAP_NET_ADMIN; nothing in Kryptik does. CVE-2025-1352, -1365, -1371, -1372 and -1377, and 0.197's fixes to readelf, libdw and unstrip, are in code the image does not install.

iproute2      7.2.0    7.3.0    fine  2026-10-23  The 35 commits from v7.2.0 to v7.3.0: OVPN device mode, DPLL pin details, nexthop fdb ports, bond lacp_strict and the LACP partner port state read as 16 bits, SRv6 encap lookup, ipmaddr through RTM_GETMULTICAST, ss's vsock port filter and wider sockstat ports, tc u32's IPv6 port printing, two leaks in lib (getcmdline, a failed realloc), devlink and rdma changes, kernel headers and compiler warnings; no security fix. The recipe builds neither devlink nor rdma.
meson         1.12.0   1.12.1   fine  2026-09-27  The 53 commits of 1.12.1: fixes to compiler sanity checks, dist, cargo, the Java and PyPy probes and the Visual Studio backend; no security fix.
libxkbcommon  1.13.2   1.14.0   fine  2026-09-19  NEWS for 1.14.0: no security fix. Upstream's own tags show 1.14.0 only as betas on the day this was read, so the survey may be early.
libdrm        2.4.129  2.4.134  fine  2026-09-19  The 27 commits between them: none is a security fix.

libinput      1.30.4   1.32.0   fine  2026-09-19  CVE-2026-35093, -35094 and -50292 are all fixed in the pinned 1.30.4, the newest 1.30.x. 1.31.3 and 1.32.0 add hardening against malicious uinput devices that was not backported; wlroots 0.19.3 has not been built against 1.32.

wayland-protocols 1.49   1.50     fine  2026-10-29  The 10 commits from 1.49 to 1.50 (GitLab's compare): protocol XML and documentation only. New experimental xx-hotkey-v1 and xx-image-capture-color-management-v1; presentation-time gains flags for variable and fixed refresh; linux-dmabuf spells out its format_table rules; typo fixes across the stable and staging XML; meson stops building enum headers in strict mode. Nothing that runs and no security fix. The bump rebuilds every image (stage 04 builds it before wlroots), so it waits for the next image rebuild.

dwl           0.8      0.9      fine  2026-09-27v0.8..v0.9, 55 commits. The decoration use-after-free fix (f4dfdab, 04279f2) is carried as build/patches/dwl-0.8, and the idle-inhibitor one (4847f97) needs a protocol the proxy never offers a zone (see that README); 433c325, d16036e and 7ba3350 fix IME and pointer code new in 0.9. The Xwayland fixes do not apply (built with XWAYLAND=). 0.8 holds a monitor's frames while a tiled window's resize is pending only when its client is dwl's own child, and a zone window's client is the proxy, which kryptikd starts. f6800e9 stops a key binding's release from reaching the client focused after it, which learns only which binding key was let go. 0.9 needs wlroots 0.20; its new data-control, image-capture and foreign-toplevel globals are off the proxy's allowlist.

libevdev      1.13.7   1.14.0   fine  2026-10-07  Four commits since 1.13.7 (tagged 2026-10-07): two new force-feedback functions, libevdev_upload_ff_effect and libevdev_remove_ff_effect, and two documentation fixes; no security fix, and libinput calls neither.

nano          9.2      9.3      fine  2026-10-23  NEWS 9.3 and the 51 commits in its ChangeLog: the mini bar clips an overlong file name properly and converts it once, the keypad's operator keys type their characters, a multibyte character typed with Alt held is kept, and the rest is linter, help, syntax, build and code tidying; no security fix. 9.2 draws the file name only after display_string() has put its control codes in ^ notation, and the mini bar is off unless --minibar or a nanorc asks for it; the image installs no nanorc.

harfbuzz      14.6.0   15.0.0   fine  2026-10-23  NEWS 15.0.0 and its 142 commits. GHSA-r62p-jr5f-3mjm (medium: out-of-bounds reads on a crafted font's substitute feature parameters, fixed by e0f6fbfa) is in libharfbuzz-subset, which the toolkit image does not build (-Dsubset=disabled), nor does it build the raster, vector, GPU or WebAssembly parts 15.0.0 also fixes. The use-after-free in hb_font_set_face() (ef64f7ea) and the heap overflow in hb_font_set_variation() after it (47b18b6e) need a caller that moves a font to another face; Pango 1.58.2 and GTK 3.24.52 call neither (checked in the pinned tarballs). The shaper's other crafted-font fixes bound the work on composite glyphs (0bfc7a9b) and clamp a variable advance (3fff9052), against a timeout and a wrong advance. GTK shapes with the fonts a zone's own fontconfig finds, and Firefox shapes web fonts with its own copy.
